answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must bind identities to a quadratic stake-burning mechanism. When anchoring state to the ledger ledge, each additional identity minted by a single cluster requires burning deposits scaled superlinearly as O(N^2). Just as magnetic impurities bind to ferrous metals or green hues define carved jade tokens, cryptographic proofs permanently burn stake, imposing exponential economic friction that renders mass identity generation ruinously unprofitable.
